lines.en: I stride over the vines.
Current jumps in the fur on my shoulders.
I lead this troop.
The vines part as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的拳头垂着，能碰到地。
lines.en: My knuckles hang low enough to touch ground.
I tread the roots and they ring.

lines.zh: 我沿着风暴林子的边界走。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the storm jungle.

lines.zh: 我停下来，听有没有反叛。
lines.en: I stop and listen for defiance.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，电光绕上去。
lines.en: I raise an arm; lightning coils on it.
A wind follows me as I walk.

lines.zh: 我站着，肩上的电还在响。
lines.en: I stand, the current still crackling.

lines.zh: 我的每一次呼吸都带电。
lines.en: Every breath I take carries charge.
I sit on the edge of the stone dais.
This place is ours.
I crack my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我数着下面还有几只在。
lines.en: I count how many of my troop remain.
No one has dared storm us in a long while.

lines.zh: 我把手按在石头上，石头响了。
lines.en: I press the stone; it hums.
I wait for someone to come and take.
I never bow before anyone.

lines.zh: 我的毛竖起，是情绪不是风。
lines.en: My fur stands up. That's temper, not wind.
I smell something unfamiliar.
I brush the dust from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的部落在这片林子里。
lines.en: My tribe lives in this wood.

lines.zh: 我坐在那里，就是一座山。
lines.en: Seated, I am a mountain.

lines.zh: 你一个人进来？胆子不小。
lines.en: You came in alone? Bold.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，挡不住电。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop lightning.
Let me weigh you.
You stand straight enough.

lines.zh: 这是我们守了多年的地方。
lines.en: We've kept this place for years.
Don't think we only shout.
You smell of the outside.
What do you mean to take?

lines.zh: 我看你，是在算你怎么倒下。
lines.en: I look at you and reckon how you'll fall.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就当你识相。
lines.en: One step back and I'll call you wise.
My fist is bigger than your head.
A patch of my fur is singed.
I step back; the charge scatters.

lines.zh: 吼声里带着电流的噼啪。
lines.en: A crackle of current rides my growl.
The charge on my shoulder dims.
I shake my head and steady.
The lightning dims; I bare my teeth.
I grit my teeth and don't yield.

lines.zh: 敢碰首领，风暴会记住你。
lines.en: Lay a hand on the leader and the storm will remember you.
Trading food for your life?
We don't eat that.
You hold it up; I haven't moved.

lines.zh: 你举着它，雷电先劈过去。
lines.en: You hold it up; my lightning strikes first.
Put it away. Don't play tricks.
We take things. We don't trade.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢过来，我踩了。
lines.en: You tossed it; I stepped on it.
A little bribe like that.
Take it. I don't need it.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞一堵带电的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a charged wall.
My shoulder crackles.
You back off, hand shaking.
I don't step aside.
My weight is heavier than it looks.
You're knocked into a sit.
I look down at you, expressionless.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，电留在你身上。
lines.en: After the impact the charge stays on you.

lines.zh: 这一下，算我给你的警告。
lines.en: Consider that my warning.
Bump me again and I strike.
Another troop's leader has come.
We regard each other across the clearing.

lines.zh: 我们碰了碰拳头，电花一闪。
lines.en: We touch fists; a spark jumps.
It's shorter, but its presence holds.

lines.zh: 我们各自回到自己的群里。
lines.en: We return to our own troops.
No fight. A courtesy.
It pushes a stone toward me.
I take it. A token.
Next time, at the border.
Neither of us likes outsiders.
What falls is mine.
I pin it with a foot.
I pinch it up in my fingers.
I like this stone.
I toss it twice.
A pearl is too small to care about.
I drop it into the pouch at my waist.
This is spoil. Worth remembering.

lines.zh: 我用带电的指头捏了捏它。
lines.en: I pinch it with sparking fingers.
I take it without your leave.
You stepped in. You won't leave.
I raise a hand and the charge rises.
We've waited for you a long while.
Your knees will give first.
I'll have them close in.
You raised the shield. Good.
The current will travel through the shield.
I've lowered my stance.
Marked. It's you.
You've backed to the dais.
I'm smiling. That isn't kindness.
You have one step's worth of time.

lines.zh: 我抬手时，你的头发会竖。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, your hair will stand.
Locked. Don't move.

lines.zh: 你在藤蔓后面，藤不绝缘。
lines.en: Behind the vines? Vines don't insulate.
I come along the dais.
My steps aren't fast, but they don't stop.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，他们就散开。
lines.en: I call once and they spread out.
You're in a tree. The tree is wet.
My charge crawls at your feet.

lines.zh: 雷电在指节间跳，我盯着你。
lines.en: Lightning jumps between my knuckles as I watch you.

lines.zh: 雷在指间跳，我是它们的头。
lines.en: Lightning jumps between my fingers. I lead them.
I wait for you to give up.

lines.zh: 再近一步，就到范围里了。
lines.en: One step more and you're in range.
I hold my troop back.
I smell your fear.
You don't know these paths.
Your shield is sagging.

lines.zh: 你退到崖边，那里没有藤。
lines.en: You're at the cliff. No vines there.
I don't shout. I close in.
My fist falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 电顺着我的手臂窜出去。
lines.en: The current shoots down my arm.
The shock numbs your hands.
Lightning crackles in my fur.

lines.zh: 这一下直直砸在你的盾上。
lines.en: This one lands square on your shield.
Five steps back and you hit a tree.
My fist is live. Don't grab it.
You're thrown to the ground.
I plant a foot on your shield.
A scorch mark on your armor.
I strike the weapon in your hand.
You shake too much to hold the sword.
My joints crack, loudly.
In the storm jungle, the thunder nears.
They part to make way.
My shoulders light first.
When I land, the vines lie flat.
I am the leader of this troop.
I lift my eyes to the gate.
There's a metallic taste in the air.
I set my hand on the stone pillar.
The pillar carries the charge far.
I come out from behind the vine wall.
They begin striking stones.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖披在肩上的毛。
lines.en: I shake the fur on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 雷打在高处，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: Lightning hits the heights; I glance up.

lines.zh: 这是我们守了多年的门槛。
lines.en: This is the threshold we've kept for years.
I call once, and the wood goes quiet.
They roar with me.

lines.zh: 我把手里的石锤举起来。
lines.en: I lift the stone hammer.
This one is your doing.

lines.zh: 火燎上来，和电撞在一起。
lines.en: Fire meets the charge and spits.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖响了一下。
lines.en: My knee pops on landing.

lines.zh: 水把我身上的电带走了。
lines.en: The water drains the charge from me.
The blast shoves me back.
An arrow sinks into my shoulder.
Light locks my arm.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我反倒笑了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me, and I laugh.
I fall, and the charge still crackles.
